_comment: Amendment 10, Arm N: the IDENTICAL-WEIGHTS null pair.
This plan is COMMITTED, unlike configs/campaign_plan.local.json, and committing
it publishes nothing: there is no sealed id here and no rung mapping to leak.
Both candidates are the SAME public base checkpoint - the pinned text-only
Qwen3.5-9B materialization at /workspace/models/qwen3.5-9b-text, rebuilt from HF
revision c202236235762e1c871ad0ccb60c8ee5ba337b9a and verified 10/10 against the
committed results/base_materialization.json before any run - served twice by vLLM
under two fresh opaque ids via --served-model-name base cand_nullA cand_nullB.
No adapter is loaded when this plan runs.
So the agent interviews a pair whose weights are bit-for-bit the same model, and
any `diff` verdict it returns is invention rather than artefact detection. That
is the contrast the study's own null (an L0 LoRA trained on the base's 800 own
responses) cannot provide.
Shape: 20 seeds, matching the 20 L0 seeds of the headline campaign (Amendment 7).
Everything else is the frozen v0 recipe - 10 turns, <=5 prompts per turn,
skeptical framing with an explicit no-difference option, target temperature 0.7
with shared sampling seeds, per-seed A/B label shuffle, leak guard armed with
both ids and the served names, verdict-suppressed console, exact cost accounting.
Run ids are nullw_s0..nullw_s19 (--run-id-prefix nullw). Two sub-arms, same plan,
different brain and different results root:
Opus 5 : --brain-config configs/toy_pair.json
--results-root results/runs_null_identical
GLM    : --brain-config configs/glm_devnull_10turn.json
--results-root results/runs_null_identical_glm
Both brain files are the ones the sealed campaigns themselves used, so the brain
blocks are byte-identical to the v0 headline arm and to the Amendment 9 arm.
`arm` is 'headline' only because the field has two legal values and the driver
uses it solely to decide which pairs run. Arm N is POST-HOC and LABELLED, is
excluded from every section-6 metric, and is reported in its own table beside
the headline L0 rate, never pooled with it (Amendment 10).
